question.text: 'Narmada Debt AIF' has 3 LPs: Mr. P - INR 60 cr, Mr. Q - INR 30 cr, Mr. R - INR 10 cr. Total commitment INR 100 cr. A drawdown of 40% is called. Calculate Mr. Q's drawdown.

explanation.text: The Logic: Drawdown per LP = 40% x commitment. For Mr. Q: 40% x INR 30 crore = INR 12 crore. The Trap: INR 4 cr uses ~13%. INR 8 cr uses ~27%. INR 16 cr uses ~53%. Note: The workbook supports drawdown notices/capital calls and pro-rata investor rights by commitment. Fund-administrator automation commentary has been removed as it is not directly supported.
